parameterProvenance.priceWeights: Entire nonnegative absolute-plus-ratio region constrained by confirmed owner choices; no model overrides or selected midpoint.
parameterProvenance.retainedScoreFraction: Existing provisional product policy: a floor at 80% of the same-model benchmark score, not retained real-world task ability.
parameterProvenance.minimumHeadroomFraction: Provisional balanced-profile protection: retain at least 10% of the observed within-model score improvement between the lowest- and highest-scoring priced native efforts. One common parameter, no family exceptions; not a task-success rate or statistical confidence bound.
parameterProvenance.boundaryProbePoints: Engineering stress probe, not a measurement confidence interval.
parameterProvenance.timePolicy: Declared auxiliary policy: time may change utility by at most one score point; 30-minute reference is a provisional scenario, not a fitted preference. Unknown timings remain unknown.
